About this tool

Enter the distance you'll travel, your vehicle's mileage (km per litre), and the current fuel price to estimate the total fuel cost for the trip.

Frequently asked questions

How is fuel cost calculated?

Fuel needed (litres) = Distance ÷ Mileage. Total cost = Fuel needed × Price per litre.

Where do I find my vehicle's mileage?

Check your vehicle's manual for the official mileage, or calculate your own by dividing distance travelled by fuel used on a recent full tank.
